objective: One mirrored Local LOW/HIGH relation after scanning the full available causal contract, not a top-5 rule list.

relation.name: TERMINAL_SWING_EXHAUSTION
relation.plain: LOW and HIGH are mirror images of one state: the active swing pushes to a fresh structural extreme, but counter-flow rises relative to continuation flow, reversal-side/defensive book depth strengthens, and continuation price-impact efficiency loses persistence. The Local is the terminal point of this divergence, not merely a breakout.
relation.components_scanned: all available causal groups and derived interactions: structure, M1/M3/M5/H1 context, trade flow, price response, L50 depth/shape, OI, mark/index/basis/funding, liquidations, 24h context, quality masks.

frozen_holdout.method: chronological 65% train + 17.5% validation for relation weighting; final 17.5% frozen test untouched

interpretation: The relation is real enough to rank true locals above hard negatives better than chance, but it is NOT yet precise enough to be called a production detector or a 95% gate.
next: Continue searching for a stronger invariant form of the same single relation across all available inputs; do not revert to candidate-only breakout classification and do not use future data in X.
